name: astex_ocd_mini
description: Oracle cross-docking mini-benchmark: 6 bidirectional pairs from Astex Diverse 85. Tier-1 (same protein, same organism) = Factor Xa (FA10_HUMAN: 1LPZ/1MQ6) + HCV NS5B (>99% seq identity: 1YVF/2D3U). Tier-2 (same enzyme, cross-viral-strain) = Neuraminidase (Inf A 1L7F / Inf B 1VCJ — labeled control; expect higher RMSD). NOTE: Astex Diverse 85 was designed for structural diversity; only 2 Tier-1 same-protein families were confirmed by UniProt+sequence inspection. DHFR cross-organism pairs (1IA1/1S3V) removed — different organisms require superposition, violating the no-superposition OCD protocol. Raw result.csv RMSD is ground-truth ONLY for Tier-1 pairs (coordinate frames match within each crystal).
schema_version_notes: v2: replaces broken DHFR cross-organism pairs with HCV NS5B Tier-1 pair confirmed by sequence identity check

tier_legend.1: Same protein, same organism — raw RMSD is valid, NO superposition needed
tier_legend.2: Same enzyme family, cross-strain/organism — raw RMSD is APPROXIMATE; coordinate frame drift expected

pairs.note: Tier-1 OCD: receptor=1LPZ (FA10_HUMAN), donor ligand=1MQ6 (FA10_HUMAN). Oracle site = 1LPZ binding_site.pdb. RMSD ref = 1LPZ native ligand. No superposition needed.
Tier-1 OCD reverse: receptor=1MQ6 (FA10_HUMAN), donor ligand=1LPZ (FA10_HUMAN). Oracle site = 1MQ6 binding_site.pdb. RMSD ref = 1MQ6 native ligand.

Tier-1 OCD: HCV NS5B RNA-dependent RNA polymerase. Sequences MSMSYTWTGALITPC... (1YVF) vs SMSYTWTGALITPC... (2D3U) are >99% identical (different HCV isolates O93077 vs Q99AU2, both 9HEPC). Raw RMSD is valid.
Tier-1 OCD reverse: HCV NS5B. receptor=2D3U (Q99AU2_9HEPC), donor=1YVF (O93077_9HEPC). >99% sequence identity. Raw RMSD is valid.

pairs.note_tier2: Influenza A (NRAM_IATRA) vs Influenza B (NRAM_INBLE). ~35% overall sequence identity; active-site catalytic residues conserved. Coordinate frames differ — raw RMSD is approximate. Use as Tier-2 control only.
Influenza B (NRAM_INBLE) vs Influenza A (NRAM_IATRA). Tier-2 control. Raw RMSD approximate only.
